csharpBaseline: Bunny Loader C# v0.1.10.16.43 / ExampleModCSharp v0.1.4
scope: NPC JavaScript examples and GlobalNPC; C# support only where implemented and verified

SetDefaults.detail: BunnyNPC.SetDefaults applies only validated basic width/height/damage/defense/lifeMax/aiStyle and limited vanilla animation fields. Sounds, color, value, town/boss defaults are absent.

SetStaticDefaults.detail: Some frame setup is represented by BunnyNPC.Frames/AnimationType properties; the C# hook SetStaticDefaults and other NPCID.Sets mutations do not exist.

ApplyBuffImmunity.detail: No per-NPC buffImmune bridge; slime's buffImmune[20] not implemented.

SetBestiary.detail: No C# bestiary entries, spawn tags, portraits or flavor text APIs.

SpawnChance.detail: No C# spawn rate callback; conditions vary by biome, rain, hardmode, day and surface.

ModifyNPCLoot.detail: No C# NPC loot rules (normal/expert, custom item, boss bag or GlobalNPC changes).

HitEffect.detail: No C# HitEffect callback or dust/gore generation bound to hit/death.

OnKill.detail: NPC.OnKill is absent; existing C# OnKill is a projectile policy, not an NPC callback.

PreAI.detail: No dynamic pre-AI callback; cannot react to per-frame NPC state.

AI.detail: Existing vanilla aiStyle=1 works, but no arbitrary per-frame managed C# NPC AI.

FindFrame.detail: No C# NPC frame callback; only vanilla animation type/frame count supported.

SetNPCNameList.detail: No C# town NPC naming integration.

SetChatButtons.detail: No C# town chat UI button bridge.

OnChatButtonClicked.detail: No C# town chat button handler.

TownNPCAttackStrength.detail: No C# town NPC attack attributes hook.

TownNPCAttackProj.detail: No C# town NPC attack projectile hook.

TownNPCAttackProjSpeed.detail: No C# town NPC projectile speed hook.

GetChat.detail: No C# chat line selection/localization bridge.
